updates.content:
Title: Users in South America may be unable to use multiple Microsoft 365 services

User impact: Users in South America may be unable to access or experience degraded functionality with multiple Microsoft 365 services

More info: Impacted services include, but are not limited to:
- Microsoft Teams
- Outlook
- Office Online Apps

Current status: We are reviewing service telemetry and available information to determine if there is an issue happening and we'll update this message shortly with our latest findings. This communication serves as a preliminary notification about a potential issue affecting your service. We'll provide an update in 30 minutes.

Scope of impact: The majority of reports are from users in Colombia. We're still assessing the scope of the issue and will update this section as we know more information.

Title: Users in South America may have been unable to use multiple Microsoft 365 services

User impact: Users in South America may have been unable to access or experience degraded functionality with multiple services.

More info: Impacted services included, but were not limited to:
- Microsoft Teams
- Outlook
- Office Online Apps

Final status: We've confirmed that the issue is resolved after an extended period of monitoring.

Scope of impact: The majority of reports were from users in Colombia.

Start time: Wednesday, August 19, 2026, at 2:15 PM UTC

End time: Wednesday, August 19, 2026, at 2:39 PM UTC

Root cause: A fiber event in the Colombia region shifted traffic onto a alternate network path, which became congested. This resulted in intermittent packet loss, traffic drops, slower connectivity, and/or higher latency. We're still investigating the full details and will provide more information within the Post Incident Report.

Next steps: - We're reviewing the networking infrastructure to better understand impact and develop action items to prevent the issue happening again.

We'll provide a preliminary Post-Incident Report within two business days and a final Post-Incident Report within five business days.
